ogSubline: See how we work and what you can expect.
title: Terms of Service
intro: Welcome to PandaTrack. We help collectors keep every order and shipment in one place so that tracking stays simple and stress-free. By using PandaTrack you agree to these terms. Please read them carefully.
acceptanceBody: By accessing or using PandaTrack (the "Service"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, do not use the Service. We may update these terms from time to time; continued use after changes means you accept the updated terms.
serviceBody: PandaTrack is a web application for tracking orders and collectible items. It lets you discover and save stores, log orders and items, track pre-orders and payments, and follow shipments in one dashboard. The Service is provided for personal, non-commercial use to organize your collecting activity. We aim to give you one source of truth for what you ordered, what is on the way, and what you still need to pay.
eligibilityBody: You must be at least 13 years old (or the minimum age in your country) to use the Service. You are responsible for keeping your account credentials secure and for all activity under your account. You must provide accurate information when signing up and keep it up to date.
conductBody:
You agree to use the Service only for lawful purposes and in line with these terms. You may not use the Service to harass others, share false or misleading information about stores or sellers, circumvent any access or security controls, or use automated means to scrape or overload the Service. We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these rules.

You may only upload content you have the rights to, images included. If an image you upload contains another person's personal data (for example, a seller's name or phone number in a chat screenshot), keep it to what is needed to log your order and use that data only for that purpose.
aiFeaturesBody:
PandaTrack includes AI-assisted features, such as creating an order from a photo. They exist so you type less, not as a guaranteed result: automated reading can get an amount, a date, a name, or any other detail wrong.

That is why nothing is saved without your review. Extracted data is shown on screen for you to review and correct, and you decide what gets saved. We are not responsible for decisions you make based on extracted data you did not review.

These features depend on an external provider and cost money per use, so they are subject to reasonable limits (for example, a monthly number of photos per account). We may adjust those limits, or suspend the feature temporarily, to keep the Service available and sustainable. The rest of the app does not depend on those limits: you can always log your orders by hand.

How the images you send to these features are handled is explained in our Privacy Policy.

If changes are significant we may notify you by email or in the app. Your continued use of the Service after the changes take effect means you accept the new terms.
contactBody: PandaTrack is an independent project, currently operated by its creator in a personal capacity (not yet incorporated as a company). If you have questions about these Terms of Service, email us at hello@pandatrack.app. You can also follow us on TikTok as @pandadcollector. We are happy to clarify how PandaTrack works and how we treat your data.
